mentions.name: TraceDB
mentions.description: Observability platform aimed at overhauling root-cause analysis. It works with OpenTelemetry tracing to piece together what failed, where a failure started, and how it spread, and the builder reports near-100% root-cause accuracy on synthetic test data while seeking validation on real production workloads.
mentions.problem: Existing observability setups charge a premium to index millions of near-identical spans, sample away the rare spans that might explain an outage, and still leave engineers to manually piece together what failed, where it started, and how it spread.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building TraceDB[1] because I think observability needs an overhaul. We pay a premium to index millions of near-identical spans, sample away the rare ones that might explain an outage, and still have to piece together what failed, where it started, and how it spread.
